slides.text:
5 workout facts every
beginner should know

1 — Muscle grows
on rest days

The gym is only the signal

2 — Soreness isn't progress

It's just newness

3 — Three sessions a week
is enough to change

4 — The best program is
the one you repeat

slides.heading: 5 — Your body sets the pace
slides.body: SOMA reads your recovery and adjusts every session to the state you actually woke up in
